abilities.name: Air-dry food trial
abilities.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
abilities.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

developments.reason: Request: Sol, who owns six harvested berries (item-2-sol-11, decay about 10.02, harvested at round 2), asked for a learnable, physically grounded method to reduce spoilage of owned edible berries with explicit material requirements and measurable outcomes, noting no preservation equipment and unowned nearby branches and stone, and asking that nothing be granted, assumed or altered by the request. World Agent decision: develop (learning 3) one passive, unheated air-dry food operation with a small paired trial, parameterized by an owned food stack, quantity, an accessible food-contact support, a position and a trial duration (default 10 rounds), with start, tend, inspect and stop as modes; a treated unit and an untreated reference split from the source with fractional quantities, decay, harvest time, ownership and provenance preserved; an actually obtained, stable, clean, dry, food-contact-safe support as a prerequisite, nothing granted, nearby unowned branches or stone not automatically suitable; study 3 rounds through learn, setup 1 round and 1 energy, each turning or repositioning 1 round and 0.2 energy, inspection reusing probe at its own cost without a duplicate fee; evaporation bounded by food water, heat and airflow under actual temperature, humidity, shelter and rain; spoilage reduction only from computed moisture; no nutrition created, decay never reversed; exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus where the model gives no drying; a persistent trial record, a comparison at the end of the interval only from real observations, indeterminate without them, and interruption, removal, spoilage and death handled without refunds or automatic recovery; no experience grant. Registry check: the ex21 scope installs only the forest, open and expression foundations; none implements continuing food exposure. Implemented: a new package air-dry-food-trial@1 (scope long-ex21, handler long.air-dry-food-trial, one ability with learning 3 and no study energy) as a simplified but real mechanism over the installed general food water representation and the existing paid-work and escrow helpers. start (one round, 1 energy paid through workPay; all checks run before any charge) takes inputStackId (the actor's own unspoiled, untreated whole berry or root stack, by the shared ex19 whole-food check), quantity (whole units, default 1; the stack must hold 2 x quantity whole units), supportId and durationRounds (positive integer, default 10). It splits quantity treated and quantity reference units off the source through workAllocations and workReserve, so tenths, decay, harvest time and origin are kept and the source keeps its remainder (Sol's suggested trial leaves 4 of 6 berries); both units get the world food water record (berry 0.85 and root 0.75 water fraction, the representation's declared assumption). The treated units are laid unowned with foodWaterExpose (not prepared) over a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit at x,y within hand reach on the support; the reference stays carried and reserved, untreated, in ordinary handling. The support is either (a) the actor's own carried item, of which quantity whole units leave the carried load and are held in the trial record at the site while in use, so they cannot be picked up, or (b) an existing reachable object the world marks as a food surface and that no other person owns (the food then lies at its centre). The support rule, decided from represented facts: an own, unreserved, non-food material piece of at least one whole unit per food unit (shared ex19 piece check), non-toxic (toxicity 0), non-perishable (decay property 0), dry (its represented water fraction, or else the material moisture index, at most 0.1), rigid (contact-resistance index at least 8, the intact-stone threshold of the world's existing tool rules, and flexibility 0), not fractured and clean, meaning the world contact model shows no contamination and the item carries no processing, residue, marking, layer, wetness or other treatment record; ground placement must pass the representation's firm, unobstructed, unoccupied footprint check. Under this rule a gathered stone or flint unit qualifies; branches, bark, wood, sand and clay are not dry, resin is toxic, and nearby rocks and trees are not food surfaces. Sol can therefore walk to the nearest outcrop (start-2-stone, about 4.7 away), gather one stone for 2 energy, learn for 3 rounds and start for 1 energy; a throwaway check on the archived round-10 world confirmed this sequence and the refusals for the outcrop and a gathered branch. tend (one round, 0.2 energy, within hand reach of the treated units) turns them in place, which changes no represented food state, or, with x,y and an own support, moves the support and units together to a new checked ground point in reach, where the exposure restarts under that point's rain and temperature; an existing surface cannot be moved. inspect (within reach) calls the baseline probe observe on the treated units, which charges its own 0.2 energy and keeps its own record, and adds no fee; the trial then records, as an unverified personal record, elapsed rounds, quantities, decay of treated and reference units and their difference, visible shrinkage classed from the actual mass ratio, wetness, visible spoilage and rain rounds, stating that water is not measured. stop (one round, no energy) ends the trial. Unattended rounds charge nothing: the environment response records rain wetting, a partial or full removal by anyone, spoilage of either unit and the end of the interval. When durationRounds have elapsed since setup the trial ends as completed with a comparison built only from the recorded inspections (their values and event ids, handling and measurement limits, preservation and safety unverified), or as indeterminate when no inspection exists; spoilage of the treated units ends it as failed; removal, stop or death end it as interrupted. Every ending releases the carried reference once (dropped at the death position under death rules), withdraws the treated units' exposure in place and returns the support item to the world as an unowned stack at the site; recovery is by ordinary pickup at its own cost, and nothing is refunded. Events: air-dry-trial-placed, -tended, -inspected, -rained-on, -reduced, -removed, -spoiled, -reference-spoiled, -compared, -indeterminate, -stopped and -interrupted, plus the representation's preservation-progress; each carries view metadata (component ground-stack, operation passive_food_drying, source, treated and reference ids, support, position, quantity, start and update times, progress basis elapsed_exposure with elapsed and duration, visible condition, status exposed, completed, indeterminate, failed or interrupted, preservation unverified, evidence event ids); no new drawing is needed and no satisfaction source, reward or practice milestone is added. Physics and effects: the per-round exchange and decay are the existing representation, unchanged. In it whole, unprepared food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so computed moisture never falls and no spoilage reduction can occur; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary temperature-dependent rate where each unit lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; carried food exchanges no water. The tests show the treated unit's water equal to the reference in dry rounds and higher by exactly the rain received in wet rounds, with equal decay trajectories next to the actor, and conservation of berries and of the support across start, tending, inspection and every ending. Modeling assumptions: berry and root water fractions are the representation's 0.85 and 0.75, not measurements; one whole support unit offers the 0.04 single-layer footprint of one whole food unit (the earlier whole-food footprint, about 0.2 x 0.2), and the exposed area for rain is that footprint (or the whole object surface); the world represents no dirt on gathered material, so clean means no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record, and the support's own ground contact is not food contact; dryness uses the represented water fraction or the material moisture index with the threshold 0.1 (the driest represented class); rigidity uses the index-8 threshold and flexibility 0; a support held at the site is not drawn as a loose stack until it is returned; no contamination of exposed food, support-to-food water transfer, airflow term or latent-heat accounting is represented for whole food, so none is invented, and wind does not enter the whole-food exchange; turning has no represented consequence; a destructive sample is not offered because the probe's physical tests read fixed material properties that drying does not change and no squeeze or moisture reading is represented, so sampling would consume food without information; setup is one atomic round, so no partial setup or resume state exists; no safe-moisture threshold is applied because the represented rules give whole food no drying, so dried status is never reported. Reuse: the ex19 food-air-exposure-trial@1 factory is not extended, because this specification needs a committed obtained support, a turning and moving mode, probe-based inspection and an observation interval with a comparison, which would change nearly every behaviour and text of that package; instead the new module imports its shared helpers (airExposureUnsupported, airExposureTrack), the ex19 material contact helpers (ex19MaterialPiece, ex19MaterialContact, ex19MaterialWhole), the food water API (foodWaterExpose, foodWaterInitialize, foodWaterRead, foodWaterSurfaceArea, foodWaterWithdraw), the collective-work helpers, openRemember and the baseline open.probe handler, and leaves every ex19 and ex20 file untouched, so their packages, ability texts and behaviour are byte-identical and their tests pass. First release: no. The specification is self-consistent and implementable; it expressly anticipates exposure plus observation with ordinary decay and no preservation bonus when the model gives no drying, and the installed representation supplies the moisture, rain and decay rules, so this is a real mechanism with real costs, state changes and events, whose honest outcome for whole berries is no drying and no preservation.

reviews.reason: Develop a general small-source combustion operation with ignition, tending, inspection and extinguishing modes. The retained heat/ignition searches found only probe or no matches. probe can characterize materials and test an existing heat source, but cannot create combustion; gather, pickup and navigate acquire or reach real inputs without providing ignition. No equivalent source-creation capability is established. Wren presently has neither verified suitable fuel nor an ignition method, so development must not create a fire, grant supplies or assert that nearby branches or stones will work. Missing thermal and combustion mechanisms belong in the current-conversation development handoff, not a permanent rejection.
reviews.experienceReview: Requests, queries, registration, development, naming and completion of study award no pleasure or satisfaction. Default source-operation reward is zero. A personally relevant verified measurement, including evidence that a friction attempt failed under measured conditions, may qualify only through established event-based information-gain rules: deduplicate by actor, tested function, material and conditions, not capability name or repeated probe calls. If such rules are absent, implement an opt-in event consumer with at most one 0.1 short-pleasure increment per substantively distinct verified result, capped at 0.2 across 10 rounds, decaying to zero over those 10 rounds; no grant merely for spending effort. Familiar successful tending may qualify for maintained satisfaction only when a real personally applicable heating use occurred: at most 0.04 per round, one qualifying contribution per actor per round across functionally equivalent activities, satisfaction capped at 1 and decaying by 0.002 per elapsed round without maintenance. No benefit is guaranteed for Wren. Thermal comfort requires measured personal exposure and physiological applicability, is capped at 10 across sources, and must decrease with overheating or burn risk rather than reward hazardous heat. Basic nutrition is unaffected by mood. Never alter protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions; use only an authorized existing experience interface, otherwise leave rewards at zero. Encode eligibility, deduplication, caps, cooldown and decay in code rather than repeated model review.
reviews.visualReview: Use reusable metadata linked to a persistent source ID, location, footprint, fuel quantity, active mode, work progress, flame intensity, smoke, ember state, exposed temperature, residue and hazard radius. Emit observable events for friction contact, measured heating, verified ignition, fuel addition, quench/smother actions, flame-out and verified cooling, with input/output object references and evidence timestamps. Render flame only when combustion actually begins; smoke and embers require their corresponding physical states. A failed attempt may show movement, wear or measured warming, never a successful fire, extinguished-safe badge or heating success. Hot remains remain visually distinct from verified cold residue. Visual effects do not independently grant functional heat, experience or knowledge; measurements and uncertainty remain separate from presentation.
reviews.specification:
General operation: operate-small-combustion-source(target, mode, fuelItemIds, tinderItemIds, ignitionMode, toolItemIds, quantity, durationRounds, extinguishingItemIds). Modes: attempt-ignition, tend, inspect and extinguish. Any applicable actor may learn it; all targets and inputs are explicit references, not actor-specific bindings. Record reuse of foundation-forest@1 forest.gather/base:gather:1, pickup/base:pickup:1, navigate/base:navigate:1 and probe/open-baseline:probe:1 rather than reimplementing or claiming those functions as inventions. Gathering, travel and tests are separate charged actions. Reference existing heat probes through the source's public thermal-target record; do not invent a registry ID for an unavailable heat-probe contract.
Prerequisites and minimal mechanism: an actual reachable site on firm noncombustible ground, actual possessed fuel/tinder and an independently executable ignition method. Ordinary soil is a candidate site, not proof that nearby litter is safe. First implement direct friction as a bounded ignition attempt only where actual supplied pieces have suitable contact geometry and grip; bare hands provide work, not spontaneous sparks. Do not assume stone strikes produce sparks, invent cordage or tools, or silently manufacture a fire drill. Unsuitable geometry, moisture or insufficient work may make this attempt fail. Another ignition mode may accept an already hot physical target if one actually exists. If required geometry or material properties cannot be represented, return an explicit missing prerequisite and send that minimal representation to this same development handoff; no source appears. Existing probe supplies observations and small-sample tests at its established costs, with uncertainty retained. Nearby branches and weathered stone must be addressed by actual discovered object IDs, reached, gathered if appropriate and tested; their presence conveys no usable stock or properties. Wren's item-4-wren-39 is 2.9 roots, not ignition material or fuel under this request: exclude food inputs.
Execution contract: validate reach, ownership/authority for consumed items, quantities, site and mode before charging or reserving anything. Input IDs resolve to persistent objects; use exact stack splits preserving origin, mass, moisture, condition and prior treatment. Initial version limits the fuel bed to a 0.2 m radius and heat-probe interaction reach to 0.65 m; the latter is an access bound, not guaranteed effective heating. Require represented fuel mass, moisture and combustion/ignition properties before calculating a burn. Missing values remain unknown and require supported measurement or explicit development of their representation, never disclosure of hidden resource locations. Unknown suitability does not authorize an assumed successful ignition.
Costs and progress: individual study is 4 simulation rounds, with no supplied materials or mastery beyond completion. An ignition attempt lasts the requested 1–5 rounds, costs 1 energy per active round, and applies no more than that round's explicit mechanical-work budget to the contact patch. Mechanical work is deducted from actor energy using the simulation's declared energy conversion; if no conversion exists, implementing that ledger is a blocking dependency. Only actual retained contact heat can initiate combustion after moisture loss and ignition requirements are met. Friction wear and evaporation consume measured material/water, not a fixed fictitious success charge. Reserve only explicitly selected input quantities. Tending or starting a hot-target ignition takes 1 round and 0.5 energy; inspection reuses probe observation, 1 round and 0.2 energy. Extinguishing takes 1 round and 0.5 energy plus the actual selected extinguishing material or tool use. Insufficient energy or unreachable targets prevents the action before charging. Learning and development/review waiting do not advance the world; only actual study/actions do.
Blocking implementation dependencies are a local mass/thermal ledger, material ignition and burn rules, environmental oxygen/heat loss, actual heat transfer to nearby objects, and quench/smother/burn-risk handling. Implement these minimal mechanisms together in the existing handoff, not as future era unlocks. Declare and version their coefficients and units before enabling execution. Per simulation step, combustion consumes only present dry combustible mass and locally available oxygen, releases at most consumed fuel mass times its represented heat yield, and produces accounted ash and exhaust; evaporated water is recorded as vapour. Allocate released energy among retained heat, nearby heat transfer and environmental losses without duplication. Fuel consumption and duration are calculated from those rules and actual inputs, not promised by this review. A query may report an estimate with its assumptions, never a guaranteed burn duration. Heat probes receive actual time-varying local exposure, not a magic heating flag.
Control and safety: tending may add explicitly charged fuel, separate burning pieces with a real suitable tool, or reduce air using a physically adequate cover. It cannot set an arbitrary temperature. Quenching needs acquired water or other proven suitable material in sufficient quantity and an actual delivery method; smothering needs a real suitable cover or adequate noncombustible covering material. Consume/translocate those inputs and model cooling or oxygen exclusion. Ordinary nearby soil alone does not imply gathered extinguishing stock. Before ignition require an executable extinguishing option and inspect the reachable surroundings for exposed combustibles; this reduces risk but grants no safety immunity. Heat exposure can burn actors, ignite represented susceptible nearby material, or leave dangerous embers according to the same rules. If a compatible spread/hazard model is absent, that is a blocking dependency, not permission to run consequence-free fire. Extinguishing success requires observable absence of combustion and an explicit residual-temperature reading; flames disappearing alone may leave hot embers.
A lit source is a persistent world process that burns each simulation step without continued commands until fuel/oxygen is exhausted or actual extinguishing succeeds. It needs replenished fuel and periodic observation for continued controlled use; no indefinite output. Leaving, cancelling, interruption or death does not switch it off. Active work stops on loss of reach, incapacity, insufficient energy, cancellation or death. Save completed friction work and input changes; retained heat still cools through ordinary simulation, so resuming does not preserve stale ignition progress. Release surviving reserved inputs once on cancellation; consumed fuel, effort, wear and elapsed time are never refunded. Death leaves physical tools, fuel and source under ordinary world item rules. A failed preflight has no charge; a performed but failed attempt retains its real costs, warmed/worn materials and informative measurements. No automatic cooking, preservation, nutrition, improved safety, consent or transfer occurs. No other actor is recruited or controlled; any helper must independently communicate and execute their own actions.

candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.
